on_actions = {
	# Give AI countries the best plane design per role. The engine creates plane designs per
	# airframe family and only with spare air XP, so most AIs never left their first design. The effect lives in
	# scripted_effects/foe_ai_air_designs.txt, generated by air-balance-simulator ai-designs.
	on_monthly = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = yes }
				foe_ai_air_designs = yes

				# Only 5 countries start with an air base, and the AI builds no planes without one:
				# once an AI reaches the air production gate (8 military factories), give it one level in its
				# capital, once.
				if = {
					limit = {
						num_of_military_factories > 7
						NOT = { has_country_flag = foe_ai_air_base_given }
						NOT = { any_owned_state = { air_base > 0 } }
						capital_scope = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = ROOT }
					}
					capital_scope = {
						add_building_construction = {
							type = air_base
							level = 1
							instant_build = yes
						}
					}
					set_country_flag = foe_ai_air_base_given
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
